purpose: Shared node/edge contract for LOC Graph RAG. The graph is derived from authoritative LOC registries and does not replace canonical ownership.
rules: Graph nodes are references to authoritative records, not replacement copies.
Edges require explicit registry evidence or deterministic structural evidence.
Semantic similarity alone must not be stored as a canonical edge.
Search-time semantic similarity may be shown separately as retrieval evidence.
LOC7 manages graph structure and traversal; LOC8 analyzes relation/trend change over time.
Unknown future relations remain unfilled until evidence exists.
